description: Three conditions on the same 42 expert-selected contexts: a small local model, a large open-weight model hosted in the cloud, and a Spanish-focused European model. Model IDs must match your provider's catalogue exactly; record the provider in your results.

conditions.name: local
conditions.role: small open-weight model on the user's own machine (data never leaves it)

conditions.name: cloud_large
conditions.role: large general open-weight model (e.g. DeepSeek V4.1 Flash or GLM-5.3, MIT licence) through a hosted OpenAI-compatible API
